get.summary: Get contacts and conversions per ad
get.description: Reports, for each ad contacts came from in a date range, how many contacts it reached (`anyTouchContacts`), how many came to you first through it (`firstTouchContacts`) and the lead/purchase conversions credited to its clicks. Ad ids match the `clickedAd` filter values (see `ads.listReferralAds`). Only clicks from when ad tracking began are counted, and conversions recorded before that are not linked to an ad. Narrow the range or `channel` if the request times out.

get.description: Lists the ads (Click-to-WhatsApp, Click-to-Messenger/Instagram and Google Ads clicks) the workspace's contacts most recently came from, newest first, with each ad's latest headline. post.description: Use this to test which knowledge chunks an AI agent (or a set of AI files) retrieves for a question, with each chunk's similarity, rank, whether it passed the threshold and, in `agentId` mode, whether the agent would actually use it (`usedByAgent`: above the provider default threshold and within the agent's top 5). `results[].agentVisible` says whether the agent would see the chunk using only these files, and `chunkIndex` gives its position in the file. Send `expectedText` to learn whether any chunk contains the answer (`expected.verdict`). `diagnosis` explains an empty or weak result. Pass exactly one of `agentId` (get it from `aiAgents.list`) or `fileIds` (get them from `aiFiles.list`). Requires a `full` token because every call spends one embedding on the workspace's own key; use `aiFiles.listChunks` to inspect chunks with a `read_only` token. Rate limited to about 30 calls per minute per workspace.

query.description: Question to embed and search for, up to 500 characters.

agentId.description: AI agent id from `aiAgents.list`: searches the files attached to that agent and reports `usedByAgent`. Provide this or `fileIds`.

fileIds.description: AI file ids from `aiFiles.list` (1–20). `usedByAgent` is null in this mode. Provide this or `agentId`.

limit.description: Maximum chunks to return (default 10, max 20). In `agentId` mode at least 5 are returned so every chunk the agent would use is visible.

similarityThreshold.description: Trial similarity threshold for `passedThreshold` only; it is not saved and never changes `usedByAgent`, `agentVisible` or agent behavior. Defaults to the embedding provider's threshold.

expectedText.description: Text you expect the answer to contain (up to 200 characters, case-insensitive, accents matter). The response `expected` says whether any chunk of the searched files contains it and whether the agent would see that chunk. Costs no extra embedding. An answer split across two chunks is reported as `notInAnyChunk`.

chunkIndex.description: 0-based position of the chunk in the document; null for chunks stored before positions existed (call aiFiles.reindex).

similarity.description: Cosine similarity (1 = identical). Not comparable across embedding models.

usedByAgent.description: agentId mode: true when the agent's search_knowledge_base tool would return this chunk (above the provider default threshold and within its top 5). null in fileIds mode.

agentVisible.description: true when the agent's search_knowledge_base tool would return this chunk if it used only the searched files: above the provider default threshold and within its top 5. Unaffected by `similarityThreshold`.

appliedConfig.description: null only when diagnosis is agentHasNoFiles (nothing was embedded).

readyChunks.description: Chunks already embedded and therefore searchable.

diagnosis.description: ok = chunks passed the threshold; noReadyChunks = no searched file has embedded chunks yet; allBelowThreshold = chunks were found but none passed; noMatches = nothing was found; agentHasNoFiles = the agent has no AI files attached.

rank.description: Rank in `results`; null when the chunk was not returned.

verdict.description: inTopResults = a chunk containing the text has agentVisible true; foundButLowRank = the text is in the files but no such chunk is agentVisible (below the default threshold or outside the top 5); notInAnyChunk = no chunk contains it (the file may be read or split wrongly, or the text spans two chunks).

expected.description: null unless `expectedText` was sent (or the agent has no files).

post.description: Re-processes one AI file (get its id from `aiFiles.list`) with the current chunker, optionally with new `chunkingConfig` parameters (chunk size, overlap, strategy, spreadsheet header row; see the field description; the effective values are in `aiFiles.get` `chunkingConfig`). Without parameters it is only needed when `chunkingOutdated = true`, when `processingStatus` is stuck at `processing`/`error`, or when `processingRun.status = error` or `processingRun.stale = true`. If a run is already active and no parameters were sent, nothing new is queued: the response has `coalesced: true` and the existing `processingRun`; if parameters were sent the call fails with 409 `conflict` and they are not applied, so retry once the run finishes. Changing parameters (or the chunker) re-embeds the whole file on the workspace key. Track progress with `aiFiles.get`: wait for `processingRun.status` to become `success` or `error` (see `processingRun.error`), then for `processingStatus = success` to know embedding finished. When chunks change, the file returns no search results from the moment the worker starts processing until embedding finishes. Requires a `full` token; rate limited to about 30 calls per minute per workspace.

Omit to keep the current parameters, send null to reset to the defaults. post.description: Moves a Page's `applyToAllCustomers` switch: ON hands every eligible customer thread to Meta Business AI (the Page's automation must be running), OFF takes them back and sends `message` (required) with the HUMAN_AGENT tag. This messages real customers. First call with `dryRun: true` to get `eligibleCount`, then call again with `confirmCount` set to the most customers you accept; it is refused when more are eligible at that moment or when the change cannot start immediately (a previous run is still winding down). It is a check at request time, not a cap: customers who become eligible while the run progresses are still included. Track progress with `aiHandover.getSettings` (`applyToAll`).

schema.description: Inbox id of the Page. Get it from `inboxes.list`.

parameters.description: Optional client-generated key (e.g. a UUID, max 255 chars) that makes this write safe to retry. Only successful responses are stored, so a failed attempt releases the key.

applyToAllCustomers.description: `true` hands every eligible customer thread to the AI; `false` takes them back.

message.description: Text sent with the HUMAN_AGENT tag when taking customers back; required for `applyToAllCustomers: false`, omit it otherwise.

dryRun.description: Only count the customers the change would touch; nothing is changed or sent.

confirmCount.description: Required unless `dryRun`: the most customers you accept being handed over or taken back. The call is refused when more are eligible at that moment, or when the change cannot start immediately. It is a check at request time, not a cap on the run: customers who become eligible while it progresses are still included. Run `dryRun` first and pass its `eligibleCount`.

eligibleCount.description: Customers the change touches, as counted for a `dryRun`; null when it was applied.

Response-time fields are in SECONDS, rounded to whole seconds: `avgResponseSeconds` (every human reply to a customer message), `avgFirstResponseSeconds` (only the first human reply in a conversation, i.e. the first reply after the customer's message when no human had yet replied), and `avgWorkingResponseSeconds` / `avgWorkingFirstResponseSeconds`, which count only the time that falls within the replying agent's working-hours schedule (outside-hours waiting is excluded; null when the agent has no schedule). An average is `null` (not 0) when the agent has no matching replies in the range; `responseCount` and `firstResponseCount` give the number of replies behind the all-replies and first-response averages (0 when none). `responseSlaEligibleCount` / `responseSlaMetCount` / `responseSlaMetPercent` (and the `firstResponse…` trio) report the response SLA (`responseSla.get`): eligible = replies whose waiting window had an SLA, percent = met / eligible, `null` when none was eligible (replies without an SLA are never counted as misses). For per-day trends use `analytics.agentResponseSeries`.

get.description: Use this to find broadcasts before inspecting one with `broadcasts.get` or stopping one with `broadcasts.stop`. Filter by `status`, `name`, `channel` or a `scheduledFrom`/`scheduledTo` window; newest first unless `sort` is given. Each broadcast includes its channel, subaction, template, audience filter and per-page targets.

schema.description: Page number, starting at 1.

field.description: Always `customField` for a workspace custom field condition.

customFieldId.description: Custom field id from `contacts.listFilterFields` (`customFields[].id`).

customFieldType.description: Exact type of the custom field (`type` in `contacts.listFilterFields`); `date`/`datetime` enable date semantics, `longText` limits operators to eq/ne/isEmpty/isNotEmpty.

valueType.description: Value type of the field, from `valueType` in `contacts.listFilterFields`; decides how the value is cast and which operators are allowed.

operator.description: Comparison operator. Allowed operators depend on the field; see `contacts.listFilterFields` (`isEmpty`/`isNotEmpty` take no value; `isBetween`/`notBetween` take a two-item value).

value.description: Value to compare against: a string, or a two-item `[from, to]` array for `isBetween`/`notBetween`. Omit for `isEmpty`/`isNotEmpty`.

field.description: Always `botField` for a workspace-level bot (account) field condition.

botFieldType.description: Exact type of the bot field (`type` in `contacts.listFilterFields`); `date`/`datetime` enable date semantics, `longText` limits operators to eq/ne/isEmpty/isNotEmpty.

valueType.description: Value type of the field, from `valueType` in `contacts.listFilterFields`; decides how the value is cast and which operators are allowed.

operator.description: Comparison operator. Allowed operators depend on the field; see `contacts.listFilterFields` (`isEmpty`/`isNotEmpty` take no value; `isBetween`/`notBetween` take a two-item value).

value.description: Value to compare against: a string, or a two-item `[from, to]` array for `isBetween`/`notBetween`. Omit for `isEmpty`/`isNotEmpty`.

field.description: Always `couponTopic` for a coupon topic condition.

topicId.description: Coupon topic id from the coupon topics list (`GET /v1/coupon-topics`).

operator.description: Allowed: `isNotEmpty` (has any coupon of the topic), `used` (has a used coupon), `eq` (has the coupon code in `value`). Only `eq` takes a value.

value.description: Coupon code to match; required for `eq`, omit otherwise.

field.description: Always `leaderboardScore` for a gamification score condition.

operator.description: Allowed: `eq`, `lt`, `lte`, `gt`, `gte` against the score in `value`.

value.description: Score to compare with (integer, sent as a number or string).

field.description: Always `pipelineItem` for a pipeline item condition.

attribute.description: Whether the contact has (or has no) matching item.

pipelineId.description: Pipeline id from `pipelines.list`; `null` = any pipeline.

operator.description: `isNotEmpty` = has an item, `isEmpty` = has no item.

value.description: Item status to look for: `any`, `open`, `won` or `lost`.

field.description: Always `pipelineItem` for a pipeline item condition.

pipelineId.description: Pipeline id from `pipelines.list`; `null` = any pipeline.

operator.description: `in` = some item has one of the statuses, `notIn` = no item does (also matches contacts without items).

field.description: Always `pipelineItem` for a pipeline item condition.

pipelineId.description: Pipeline id from `pipelines.list`. Required: stages belong to one pipeline.

operator.description: `in` = some item sits in one of the stages, `notIn` = no item does (also matches contacts without items).

value.description: Stage ids of `pipelineId`. Get them from `pipelines.get` or `contacts.listFilterFields`.

field.description: Always `pipelineItem` for a pipeline item condition.

pipelineId.description: Pipeline id from `pipelines.list`; `null` = any pipeline.

operator.description: `in` = some item has one of the priorities, `notIn` = no item does (also matches contacts without items).

field.description: Always `ctwaRetarget`: contacts from Click-to-WhatsApp/Messenger/Instagram ads in a segment and date range.

segment.description: Ad funnel stage to target: `conversations`, `leads` or `purchases`.

adId.description: Restrict to contacts from this ad id. Omit for all ads.

integrationWhatsappId.description: Restrict to one WhatsApp integration id (numeric string). Omit for all.

channel.description: Restrict to one ads-eligible channel (`whatsapp`, `messenger` or `instagram`). Omit for the WhatsApp-only default.

until.description: Range end, inclusive (UTC date `YYYY-MM-DD`); must not precede `since` and the span is capped.

conditions.description: Conditions to combine. Each has `field`, `operator` and usually `value`; dynamic fields use `field: customField|botField|couponTopic|leaderboardScore|pipelineItem` with their id (`pipelineItem` also takes `attribute` and `pipelineId`). See `contacts.listFilterFields`.

timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. `Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh`) used to interpret date/datetime values without an offset. Defaults to UTC.

contactFilter.description: Structured filter selecting the recipient audience. See `contacts.listFilterFields`.

audienceRangeStart.description: 1-based inclusive start of the ordered audience window (ascending contact inbox id). Omit to start from the first contact.

audienceRangeEnd.description: 1-based inclusive end of the ordered audience window. Omit to include through the last contact.

sendRatePerMinute.description: Maximum recipients handed off per dispatch minute (1-1000). Omit to use your plan's default (500; Messenger broadcasts on a trial plan use and cap at 60).

saveAsDraft.description: Save as a draft instead of scheduling/sending immediately.

templateParams.description: Template values by key, e.g. `{"body.1": "Ann", "header": "https://.../a.jpg"}`. The keys are the `parameters` of `whatsappTemplates.get` / `messengerTemplates.get`. Use this or `templateData`, not both; a missing, unknown or invalid key is a 422 that lists the keys.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional client-generated key (e.g. a UUID, max 255 chars) that makes this write safe to retry. Replaying the same key on the same operation within 24 hours returns the original 2xx response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; reusing it with a different payload returns 422, and a key whose first request is still running returns 409. Only successful responses are stored, so a failed attempt releases the key.

post.description: Counts and lists the contact inboxes a broadcast would be sent to, without creating anything. `total` is the size of the whole audience (the `audienceRangeStart`/`audienceRangeEnd` window already applied, one contact on several channels counts once per channel); `data` is one page of it in send order (ascending contact inbox id), `page` from 1 and `perPage` up to 50. Select the audience like `broadcasts.create`: `subaction`, `contactFilter`, the window, and the inboxes with `inboxIds`, or `channels` (`omnichannel` = every channel), or an integration id; none given means an empty audience (`total` 0). `fullName`, `avatar` and `occurredAt` come from the contact. Use `perPage: 1` when you only need `total`. On very large audiences pass `countMode: "bounded"`: the count then stops at `countCap` and `totalCountCapped: true` means `total` is a lower bound (it can even be 0 when the window starts past `countCap`, which is not an empty audience); an exact count that takes too long fails with 503 `countTimeout`. A page past the window is empty. Use `broadcasts.getAudience` for a broadcast that already exists.

inboxIds.description: Inbox ids (numeric strings) the broadcast would send from. Get them from `inboxes.list`. Pick the audience with `inboxIds`, or with `channels` (`omnichannel` means every channel), or with an integration id; when you give none of them the audience is empty.

channels.description: Channels to send on; `omnichannel` means every channel. Needed when `inboxIds` is omitted.

integrationWhatsappId.description: Only inboxes of this WhatsApp integration id. Get it from `whatsappChannels.list`.

integrationMessengerId.description: Only inboxes of this Messenger integration id. Get it from `messengerChannels.list`.

subaction.description: Audience sub-action filter, the same value `broadcasts.create` takes.

operator.description: How conditions combine: `and` = contact must match all, `or` = any.

field.description: Always `couponTopic` for a coupon topic condition.

topicId.description: Coupon topic id from the coupon topics list (`GET /v1/coupon-topics`).

operator.description: Allowed: `isNotEmpty` (has any coupon of the topic), `used` (has a used coupon), `eq` (has the coupon code in `value`). Only `eq` takes a value.

value.description: Coupon code to match; required for `eq`, omit otherwise.

field.description: Always `leaderboardScore` for a gamification score condition.

operator.description: Allowed: `eq`, `lt`, `lte`, `gt`, `gte` against the score in `value`.

value.description: Score to compare with (integer, sent as a number or string).

field.description: Always `pipelineItem` for a pipeline item condition.

attribute.description: Whether the contact has (or has no) matching item.

pipelineId.description: Pipeline id from `pipelines.list`; `null` = any pipeline.

operator.description: `isNotEmpty` = has an item, `isEmpty` = has no item.

value.description: Item status to look for: `any`, `open`, `won` or `lost`.

field.description: Always `pipelineItem` for a pipeline item condition.

pipelineId.description: Pipeline id from `pipelines.list`; `null` = any pipeline.

operator.description: `in` = some item has one of the statuses, `notIn` = no item does (also matches contacts without items).

operator.description: `in` = some item sits in one of the stages, `notIn` = no item does (also matches contacts without items).

value.description: Stage ids of `pipelineId`. Get them from `pipelines.get` or `contacts.listFilterFields`.

field.description: Always `pipelineItem` for a pipeline item condition.

pipelineId.description: Pipeline id from `pipelines.list`; `null` = any pipeline.

operator.description: `in` = some item has one of the priorities, `notIn` = no item does (also matches contacts without items).

field.description: Always `ctwaRetarget`: contacts from Click-to-WhatsApp/Messenger/Instagram ads in a segment and date range.

segment.description: Ad funnel stage to target: `conversations`, `leads` or `purchases`.

adId.description: Restrict to contacts from this ad id. Omit for all ads.

integrationWhatsappId.description: Restrict to one WhatsApp integration id (numeric string). Omit for all.

channel.description: Restrict to one ads-eligible channel (`whatsapp`, `messenger` or `instagram`). Omit for the WhatsApp-only default.

until.description: Range end, inclusive (UTC date `YYYY-MM-DD`); must not precede `since` and the span is capped.

conditions.description: Conditions to combine. Each has `field`, `operator` and usually `value`; dynamic fields use `field: customField|botField|couponTopic|leaderboardScore|pipelineItem` with their id (`pipelineItem` also takes `attribute` and `pipelineId`). See `contacts.listFilterFields`.

timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. `Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh`) used to interpret date/datetime values without an offset. Defaults to UTC.

contactFilter.description: Structured filter for advanced matching beyond `keyword`. See `contacts.listFilterFields` for the field/operator reference. An invalid filter is rejected (422) rather than ignored.

audienceRangeStart.description: 1-based inclusive start of the ordered audience window (ascending contact inbox id). Omit to start from the first contact.

audienceRangeEnd.description: 1-based inclusive end of the ordered audience window. Omit to include through the last contact.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

countMode.description: `exact` (default) counts every match and answers 503 `countTimeout` if that takes too long. `bounded` stops at 100000 and sets `totalCountCapped`, so `total` is then a lower bound.

total.description: Size of the whole audience (the audience window applied), not just this page. A contact on several channels counts once per channel. A lower bound when `totalCountCapped` is true.

totalCountCapped.description: True when `countMode` was `bounded` and the count stopped at `countCap`; `total` is then a lower bound.

countCap.description: The cap a bounded count stops at. Absent for exact counts.

contactInboxId.description: Contact inbox id (one per contact per channel).

avatar.description: Absolute avatar URL, or null when the contact has none.

occurredAt.description: ISO 8601 time the contact was created.

conversationId.description: Direct-message conversation id, or null when none exists.

parameters.description: Optional client-generated key (e.g. a UUID, max 255 chars) that makes this write safe to retry. Replaying the same key on the same operation within 24 hours returns the original 2xx response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; reusing it with a different payload returns 422, and a key whose first request is still running returns 409. Only successful responses are stored, so a failed attempt releases the key.

schedulesType.description: When to send: immediately (`now`), once at `schedulesAt` (`future`), or on a repeating schedule (`recurring`, with `recurrence`).

monthDay.description: Monthly only. Day 29–31 runs on the last day of shorter months; "last" always means the last day.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name, e.g. Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh.

excludeDates.description: Local dates (YYYY-MM-DD, in `timezone`) that must not send. The series keeps running and the skipped run is recorded as skipped. At most 366.

recurrence.description: The repeat rule. Required when `schedulesType` is `recurring`, and only then. Preview its next runs with `broadcasts.previewRecurrence`.

schedulesAt.description: ISO 8601 send time, required when schedulesType is `future` and not a draft.

customFieldType.description: Exact type of the custom field (`type` in `contacts.listFilterFields`); `date`/`datetime` enable date semantics, `longText` limits operators to eq/ne/isEmpty/isNotEmpty.

valueType.description: Value type of the field, from `valueType` in `contacts.listFilterFields`; decides how the value is cast and which operators are allowed.

field.description: Always `couponTopic` for a coupon topic condition.

topicId.description: Coupon topic id from the coupon topics list (`GET /v1/coupon-topics`).

operator.description: Allowed: `isNotEmpty` (has any coupon of the topic), `used` (has a used coupon), `eq` (has the coupon code in `value`). Only `eq` takes a value.

value.description: Coupon code to match; required for `eq`, omit otherwise.

field.description: Always `leaderboardScore` for a gamification score condition.

operator.description: Allowed: `eq`, `lt`, `lte`, `gt`, `gte` against the score in `value`.

value.description: Score to compare with (integer, sent as a number or string).

field.description: Always `pipelineItem` for a pipeline item condition.

attribute.description: Whether the contact has (or has no) matching item.

pipelineId.description: Pipeline id from `pipelines.list`; `null` = any pipeline.

operator.description: `isNotEmpty` = has an item, `isEmpty` = has no item.

value.description: Item status to look for: `any`, `open`, `won` or `lost`.

field.description: Always `pipelineItem` for a pipeline item condition.

pipelineId.description: Pipeline id from `pipelines.list`; `null` = any pipeline.

operator.description: `in` = some item has one of the statuses, `notIn` = no item does (also matches contacts without items).

field.description: Always `pipelineItem` for a pipeline item condition.

pipelineId.description: Pipeline id from `pipelines.list`. Required: stages belong to one pipeline.

operator.description: `in` = some item sits in one of the stages, `notIn` = no item does (also matches contacts without items).

value.description: Stage ids of `pipelineId`. Get them from `pipelines.get` or `contacts.listFilterFields`.

field.description: Always `pipelineItem` for a pipeline item condition.

pipelineId.description: Pipeline id from `pipelines.list`; `null` = any pipeline.

operator.description: `in` = some item has one of the priorities, `notIn` = no item does (also matches contacts without items).

field.description: Always `ctwaRetarget`: contacts from Click-to-WhatsApp/Messenger/Instagram ads in a segment and date range.

segment.description: Ad funnel stage to target: `conversations`, `leads` or `purchases`.

adId.description: Restrict to contacts from this ad id. Omit for all ads.

integrationWhatsappId.description: Restrict to one WhatsApp integration id (numeric string). Omit for all.

channel.description: Restrict to one ads-eligible channel (`whatsapp`, `messenger` or `instagram`). Omit for the WhatsApp-only default.

until.description: Range end, inclusive (UTC date `YYYY-MM-DD`); must not precede `since` and the span is capped.

conditions.description: Conditions to combine. Each has `field`, `operator` and usually `value`; dynamic fields use `field: customField|botField|couponTopic|leaderboardScore|pipelineItem` with their id (`pipelineItem` also takes `attribute` and `pipelineId`). See `contacts.listFilterFields`.

timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. `Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh`) used to interpret date/datetime values without an offset. Defaults to UTC.

contactFilter.description: Structured filter selecting the recipient audience. See `contacts.listFilterFields`.

audienceRangeStart.description: 1-based inclusive start of the ordered audience window (ascending contact inbox id). Omit to start from the first contact.

audienceRangeEnd.description: 1-based inclusive end of the ordered audience window. Omit to include through the last contact.

sendRatePerMinute.description: Maximum recipients handed off per dispatch minute (1-1000). Omit to use your plan's default (500; Messenger broadcasts on a trial plan use and cap at 60).

saveAsDraft.description: Save as a draft instead of scheduling/sending immediately.

templateParams.description: Template values by key, e.g. `{"body.1": "Ann", "header": "https://.../a.jpg"}`. The keys are the `parameters` of `whatsappTemplates.get` / `messengerTemplates.get`. Use this or `templateData`, not both; a missing, unknown or invalid key is a 422 that lists the keys.

schema.description: Broadcast id. Get it from `broadcasts.list`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional client-generated key (e.g. a UUID, max 255 chars) that makes this write safe to retry. Replaying the same key on the same operation within 24 hours returns the original 2xx response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; reusing it with a different payload returns 422, and a key whose first request is still running returns 409. Only successful responses are stored, so a failed attempt releases the key.

schedulesType.description: When to send: immediately (`now`), once at `schedulesAt` (`future`), or on a repeating schedule (`recurring`).

schedulesAt.description: ISO 8601 send time, required when schedulesType is `future`.

monthDay.description: Monthly only. Day 29–31 runs on the last day of shorter months; "last" always means the last day.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name, e.g. Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh.

excludeDates.description: Local dates (YYYY-MM-DD, in `timezone`) that must not send. The series keeps running and the skipped run is recorded as skipped. At most 366.

recurrence.description: The repeat rule for `recurring`. Omit to keep the rule saved on the draft.

sendRatePerMinute.description: Maximum recipients handed off per dispatch minute (1-1000). Omit to keep the stored rate; null clears it.

post.description: Credential-strategy providers (`token`/`api_key`/`self_serve`) connect immediately and return `connection` (`session: null`). `webchat` and `api` are self-serve channels; API returns its bearer token once in `secret.token`, and webchat accepts its branding and behavior fields in `config` using the `POST /v1/webchats` shape. OAuth providers (`oauth_redirect`/`oauth_popup`) return `connection: null` and a `session` whose `nextAction` is `{type:"open_url", url}` — show that URL to the person connecting, then poll `connectSessions.get` until `awaiting_selection` (a multi-account provider) or `completed` (a single-account provider), then call `connectSessions.connectTargets` to finish a multi-account connect. Call `connectionProviders.list` first to find the provider key and required `config` fields. The person opening the URL must have admin rights on the account being connected: the resulting token belongs to them, so hand each person their own link — a leaked URL can only connect the opener's account into this workspace…

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional client-generated key (e.g. a UUID, max 255 chars) that makes this write safe to retry. Replaying the same key on the same operation within 24 hours returns the original 2xx response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; reusing it with a different payload returns 422, and a key whose first request is still running returns 409. Only successful responses are stored, so a failed attempt releases the key.

topicId.description: Coupon topic id from the coupon topics list (`GET /v1/coupon-topics`).

operator.description: Allowed: `isNotEmpty` (has any coupon of the topic), `used` (has a used coupon), `eq` (has the coupon code in `value`). Only `eq` takes a value.

value.description: Coupon code to match; required for `eq`, omit otherwise.

operator.description: Allowed: `eq`, `lt`, `lte`, `gt`, `gte` against the score in `value`.

attribute.description: Whether the contact has (or has no) matching item.

pipelineId.description: Pipeline id from `pipelines.list`; `null` = any pipeline.

operator.description: `isNotEmpty` = has an item, `isEmpty` = has no item.

value.description: Item status to look for: `any`, `open`, `won` or `lost`.

pipelineId.description: Pipeline id from `pipelines.list`; `null` = any pipeline.

operator.description: `in` = some item has one of the statuses, `notIn` = no item does (also matches contacts without items).

pipelineId.description: Pipeline id from `pipelines.list`. Required: stages belong to one pipeline.

operator.description: `in` = some item sits in one of the stages, `notIn` = no item does (also matches contacts without items).

value.description: Stage ids of `pipelineId`. Get them from `pipelines.get` or `contacts.listFilterFields`.

field.description: Always `pipelineItem` for a pipeline item condition.

pipelineId.description: Pipeline id from `pipelines.list`; `null` = any pipeline.

operator.description: `in` = some item has one of the priorities, `notIn` = no item does (also matches contacts without items).

field.description: Always `ctwaRetarget`: contacts from Click-to-WhatsApp/Messenger/Instagram ads in a segment and date range.

segment.description: Ad funnel stage to target: `conversations`, `leads` or `purchases`.

adId.description: Restrict to contacts from this ad id. Omit for all ads.

integrationWhatsappId.description: Restrict to one WhatsApp integration id (numeric string). Omit for all.

channel.description: Restrict to one ads-eligible channel (`whatsapp`, `messenger` or `instagram`). Omit for the WhatsApp-only default.

until.description: Range end, inclusive (UTC date `YYYY-MM-DD`); must not precede `since` and the span is capped.

conditions.description: Conditions to combine. Each has `field`, `operator` and usually `value`; dynamic fields use `field: customField|botField|couponTopic|leaderboardScore|pipelineItem` with their id (`pipelineItem` also takes `attribute` and `pipelineId`). See `contacts.listFilterFields`.

timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. `Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh`) used to interpret date/datetime values without an offset. Defaults to UTC.

contactFilter.description: Structured filter for advanced matching beyond `keyword`. See `contacts.listFilterFields` for the field/operator reference. An invalid filter is rejected (422) rather than ignored.

channels.description: Restrict to contacts with at least one inbox on one of these channels.

integrationWhatsappId.description: Restrict to contacts reachable via this WhatsApp integration id.

integrationMessengerId.description: Restrict to contacts reachable via this Messenger integration id.

inboxIds.description: Restrict to contacts with at least one conversation in one of these inbox ids.

include.description: Relations to embed in each contact. Omit to include everything (default); pass an empty selection or a narrower list — e.g. `["tags"]` — to shrink the response when scanning many contacts.

withCount.description: Whether to compute totalCount/pageCount. Set to false to skip the count query when you only need the rows — faster on large workspaces.

contactCustomFields.description: Stored values keyed by `customFieldId`, without field names or types. Use `contacts.listCustomFields` for each value with its field's name and type.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional client-generated key (e.g. a UUID, max 255 chars) that makes this write safe to retry. Replaying the same key on the same operation within 24 hours returns the original 2xx response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; reusing it with a different payload returns 422, and a key whose first request is still running returns 409. Only successful responses are stored, so a failed attempt releases the key.

get.description: Counts contacts matching the same filter shape as `contacts.list`, without paginating the rows. Pass `countMode: "bounded"` on very large workspaces: the count then stops at `countCap` and `totalCountCapped` says `total` is a lower bound. An exact count that takes too long fails with 503 `countTimeout`.

field.description: Always `customField` for a workspace custom field condition.

customFieldId.description: Custom field id from `contacts.listFilterFields` (`customFields[].id`).

customFieldType.description: Exact type of the custom field (`type` in `contacts.listFilterFields`); `date`/`datetime` enable date semantics, `longText` limits operators to eq/ne/isEmpty/isNotEmpty.

valueType.description: Value type of the field, from `valueType` in `contacts.listFilterFields`; decides how the value is cast and which operators are allowed.

operator.description: Comparison operator. Allowed operators depend on the field; see `contacts.listFilterFields` (`isEmpty`/`isNotEmpty` take no value; `isBetween`/`notBetween` take a two-item value).

value.description: Value to compare against: a string, or a two-item `[from, to]` array for `isBetween`/`notBetween`. Omit for `isEmpty`/`isNotEmpty`.

field.description: Always `botField` for a workspace-level bot (account) field condition.

botFieldType.description: Exact type of the bot field (`type` in `contacts.listFilterFields`); `date`/`datetime` enable date semantics, `longText` limits operators to eq/ne/isEmpty/isNotEmpty.

valueType.description: Value type of the field, from `valueType` in `contacts.listFilterFields`; decides how the value is cast and which operators are allowed.

operator.description: Comparison operator. Allowed operators depend on the field; see `contacts.listFilterFields` (`isEmpty`/`isNotEmpty` take no value; `isBetween`/`notBetween` take a two-item value).

value.description: Value to compare against: a string, or a two-item `[from, to]` array for `isBetween`/`notBetween`. Omit for `isEmpty`/`isNotEmpty`.

field.description: Always `couponTopic` for a coupon topic condition.

topicId.description: Coupon topic id from the coupon topics list (`GET /v1/coupon-topics`).

operator.description: Allowed: `isNotEmpty` (has any coupon of the topic), `used` (has a used coupon), `eq` (has the coupon code in `value`). Only `eq` takes a value.

value.description: Coupon code to match; required for `eq`, omit otherwise.

field.description: Always `leaderboardScore` for a gamification score condition.

operator.description: Allowed: `eq`, `lt`, `lte`, `gt`, `gte` against the score in `value`.

value.description: Score to compare with (integer, sent as a number or string).

field.description: Always `pipelineItem` for a pipeline item condition.

attribute.description: Whether the contact has (or has no) matching item.

pipelineId.description: Pipeline id from `pipelines.list`; `null` = any pipeline.

operator.description: `isNotEmpty` = has an item, `isEmpty` = has no item.

value.description: Item status to look for: `any`, `open`, `won` or `lost`.

field.description: Always `pipelineItem` for a pipeline item condition.

pipelineId.description: Pipeline id from `pipelines.list`; `null` = any pipeline.

operator.description: `in` = some item has one of the statuses, `notIn` = no item does (also matches contacts without items).

field.description: Always `pipelineItem` for a pipeline item condition.

pipelineId.description: Pipeline id from `pipelines.list`. Required: stages belong to one pipeline.

operator.description: `in` = some item sits in one of the stages, `notIn` = no item does (also matches contacts without items).

value.description: Stage ids of `pipelineId`. Get them from `pipelines.get` or `contacts.listFilterFields`.

field.description: Always `pipelineItem` for a pipeline item condition.

pipelineId.description: Pipeline id from `pipelines.list`; `null` = any pipeline.

operator.description: `in` = some item has one of the priorities, `notIn` = no item does (also matches contacts without items).

field.description: Always `ctwaRetarget`: contacts from Click-to-WhatsApp/Messenger/Instagram ads in a segment and date range.

segment.description: Ad funnel stage to target: `conversations`, `leads` or `purchases`.

adId.description: Restrict to contacts from this ad id. Omit for all ads.

integrationWhatsappId.description: Restrict to one WhatsApp integration id (numeric string). Omit for all.

channel.description: Restrict to one ads-eligible channel (`whatsapp`, `messenger` or `instagram`). Omit for the WhatsApp-only default.

until.description: Range end, inclusive (UTC date `YYYY-MM-DD`); must not precede `since` and the span is capped.

conditions.description: Conditions to combine. Each has `field`, `operator` and usually `value`; dynamic fields use `field: customField|botField|couponTopic|leaderboardScore|pipelineItem` with their id (`pipelineItem` also takes `attribute` and `pipelineId`). See `contacts.listFilterFields`.

timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. `Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh`) used to interpret date/datetime values without an offset. Defaults to UTC.

schema.description: Structured filter for advanced matching beyond `keyword`. See `contacts.listFilterFields` for the field/operator reference. An invalid filter is rejected (422) rather than ignored.
Restrict to contacts with at least one inbox on one of these channels.
Restrict to contacts reachable via this WhatsApp integration id.
Restrict to contacts reachable via this Messenger integration id.
Restrict to contacts with at least one conversation in one of these inbox ids.
Broadcast recipient sub-action filter.
`exact` (default) counts every match and answers 503 `countTimeout` if that takes too long. `bounded` stops at 100000 and sets `totalCountCapped`, so `total` is then a lower bound.

total.description: Number of contacts matching the filter (a lower bound when `totalCountCapped` is true).

totalCountCapped.description: True when `countMode` was `bounded` and the count stopped at `countCap`; `total` is then a lower bound.

countCap.description: The cap a bounded count stops at. Absent for exact counts.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional client-generated key (e.g. a UUID, max 255 chars) that makes this write safe to retry. Replaying the same key on the same operation within 24 hours returns the original 2xx response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; reusing it with a different payload returns 422, and a key whose first request is still running returns 409. Only successful responses are stored, so a failed attempt releases the key.

patch.summary: Apply arithmetic/append operations to custom field
patch.description: Applies a batch of operations to one or more custom fields on the contact, in the given order, each addressed by id or name. Each operation is one of `set`, `append`, `prepend`, `increase`, `decrease`: `set` overwrites the current value, `append`/`prepend` concatenate onto it, and `increase`/`decrease` treat the current value as a number (no-op if it is not numeric). On a field with no value yet, every operation uses `value` as the initial value, validated and normalized for the field type like `contacts.setCustomField`. This is the batch equivalent of `contacts.setCustomField` for changing several fields in one call. Example: `{"operations":[{"customFieldId":"123","operation":"increase","value":"1"}]}` to increment a numeric field.

post.description: Enqueues a CSV export of contacts and returns immediately with a `fileId` — poll `GET /v1/contacts/export-files/{fileId}` for status and the download URL once it finishes. fields.description: CSV columns, each prefixed by kind: `sys:<column>` for a contact column (firstName, lastName, fullName, email, phoneNumber, gender, source, lastReadAt, blockedAt, contactId = platform id, sourceUserId = WhatsApp BSUID), `cus:<customFieldId>` for a custom field, `tag:<tagId>` for a tag (yes/no column). A key without a prefix is rejected.

contactIds.description: Specific contact ids to export. Required unless `exportAll` is true.

exportAll.description: Export every contact matching `filter` (or the whole workspace if omitted).

keyword.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the contact's name, email, or phone.

operator.description: How conditions combine: `and` = contact must match all, `or` = any.

field.description: Contact filter field key. Valid keys and their operators are listed by `contacts.listFilterFields`.

operator.description: Comparison operator. Allowed operators depend on the field; see `contacts.listFilterFields` (`isEmpty`/`isNotEmpty` take no value; `isBetween`/`notBetween` take a two-item value).

value.description: Value to compare: a string, an array of ids/strings for `in`/`notIn`, or a two-item `[from, to]` array for `isBetween`/`notBetween`. Omit for `isEmpty`/`isNotEmpty`.

field.description: Always `couponTopic` for a coupon topic condition.

topicId.description: Coupon topic id from the coupon topics list (`GET /v1/coupon-topics`).

operator.description: Allowed: `isNotEmpty` (has any coupon of the topic), `used` (has a used coupon), `eq` (has the coupon code in `value`). Only `eq` takes a value.

value.description: Coupon code to match; required for `eq`, omit otherwise.

field.description: Always `leaderboardScore` for a gamification score condition.

operator.description: Allowed: `eq`, `lt`, `lte`, `gt`, `gte` against the score in `value`.

value.description: Score to compare with (integer, sent as a number or string).

attribute.description: Whether the contact has (or has no) matching item.

pipelineId.description: Pipeline id from `pipelines.list`; `null` = any pipeline.

operator.description: `isNotEmpty` = has an item, `isEmpty` = has no item.

value.description: Item status to look for: `any`, `open`, `won` or `lost`.

field.description: Always `pipelineItem` for a pipeline item condition.

pipelineId.description: Pipeline id from `pipelines.list`; `null` = any pipeline.

operator.description: `in` = some item has one of the statuses, `notIn` = no item does (also matches contacts without items).

pipelineId.description: Pipeline id from `pipelines.list`. Required: stages belong to one pipeline.

operator.description: `in` = some item sits in one of the stages, `notIn` = no item does (also matches contacts without items).

value.description: Stage ids of `pipelineId`. Get them from `pipelines.get` or `contacts.listFilterFields`.

pipelineId.description: Pipeline id from `pipelines.list`; `null` = any pipeline.

segment.description: Ad funnel stage to target: `conversations`, `leads` or `purchases`.

adId.description: Restrict to contacts from this ad id. Omit for all ads.

integrationWhatsappId.description: Restrict to one WhatsApp integration id (numeric string). Omit for all.

channel.description: Restrict to one ads-eligible channel (`whatsapp`, `messenger` or `instagram`). Omit for the WhatsApp-only default.

until.description: Range end, inclusive (UTC date `YYYY-MM-DD`); must not precede `since` and the span is capped.

conditions.description: Conditions to combine. Each has `field`, `operator` and usually `value`; dynamic fields use `field: customField|botField|couponTopic|leaderboardScore|pipelineItem` with their id (`pipelineItem` also takes `attribute` and `pipelineId`). See `contacts.listFilterFields`.

timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. `Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh`) used to interpret date/datetime values without an offset. Defaults to UTC.

contactFilter.description: Structured filter for advanced matching beyond keyword. See `contacts.listFilterFields` for the field/operator reference.

fileId.description: Export file id (numeric string). Poll `contacts.getExportFile` with it.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional client-generated key (e.g. a UUID, max 255 chars) that makes this write safe to retry. Replaying the same key on the same operation within 24 hours returns the original 2xx response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; reusing it with a different payload returns 422, and a key whose first request is still running returns 409. Only successful responses are stored, so a failed attempt releases the key.

field.description: Always `couponTopic` for a coupon topic condition.

topicId.description: Coupon topic id from the coupon topics list (`GET /v1/coupon-topics`).

operator.description: Allowed: `isNotEmpty` (has any coupon of the topic), `used` (has a used coupon), `eq` (has the coupon code in `value`). Only `eq` takes a value.

value.description: Coupon code to match; required for `eq`, omit otherwise.

field.description: Always `leaderboardScore` for a gamification score condition.

operator.description: Allowed: `eq`, `lt`, `lte`, `gt`, `gte` against the score in `value`.

value.description: Score to compare with (integer, sent as a number or string).

field.description: Always `pipelineItem` for a pipeline item condition.

attribute.description: Whether the contact has (or has no) matching item.

pipelineId.description: Pipeline id from `pipelines.list`; `null` = any pipeline.

operator.description: `isNotEmpty` = has an item, `isEmpty` = has no item.

value.description: Item status to look for: `any`, `open`, `won` or `lost`.

field.description: Always `pipelineItem` for a pipeline item condition.

pipelineId.description: Pipeline id from `pipelines.list`; `null` = any pipeline.

operator.description: `in` = some item has one of the statuses, `notIn` = no item does (also matches contacts without items).

field.description: Always `pipelineItem` for a pipeline item condition.

operator.description: `in` = some item sits in one of the stages, `notIn` = no item does (also matches contacts without items).

value.description: Stage ids of `pipelineId`. Get them from `pipelines.get` or `contacts.listFilterFields`.

field.description: Always `pipelineItem` for a pipeline item condition.

pipelineId.description: Pipeline id from `pipelines.list`; `null` = any pipeline.

operator.description: `in` = some item has one of the priorities, `notIn` = no item does (also matches contacts without items).

field.description: Always `ctwaRetarget`: contacts from Click-to-WhatsApp/Messenger/Instagram ads in a segment and date range.

segment.description: Ad funnel stage to target: `conversations`, `leads` or `purchases`.

adId.description: Restrict to contacts from this ad id. Omit for all ads.

integrationWhatsappId.description: Restrict to one WhatsApp integration id (numeric string). Omit for all.

channel.description: Restrict to one ads-eligible channel (`whatsapp`, `messenger` or `instagram`). Omit for the WhatsApp-only default.

until.description: Range end, inclusive (UTC date `YYYY-MM-DD`); must not precede `since` and the span is capped.

conditions.description: Conditions to combine. Each has `field`, `operator` and usually `value`; dynamic fields use `field: customField|botField|couponTopic|leaderboardScore|pipelineItem` with their id (`pipelineItem` also takes `attribute` and `pipelineId`). See `contacts.listFilterFields`.

timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. `Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh`) used to interpret date/datetime values without an offset. Defaults to UTC.

isActive.description: Off refuses the code without deleting it.

code.description: What the customer types; matched ignoring case.

productIds.description: With `appliesTo: products`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional client-generated key (e.g. a UUID, max 255 chars) that makes this write safe to retry. Replaying the same key on the same operation within 24 hours returns the original 2xx response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; reusing it with a different payload returns 422, and a key whose first request is still running returns 409. Only successful responses are stored, so a failed attempt releases the key.

code.description: 3–64 letters, digits, `-` or `_`. Unique per workspace, ignoring case. `discountCodes.generateCode` suggests a free one.

autoApply.description: Apply to web shop carts without the customer typing it. With several, the one taking off the most wins.

discountValue.description: Percent 1–100 or an amount above 0; ignored for `freeShipping`.

productIds.description: Products for `appliesTo: products`. Get them from `products.list`.

minimumType.description: `none`, a minimum `amount` or a minimum `quantity` of items, read on the lines the code applies to.

minimumValue.description: Amount or number of items for `minimumType` `amount` / `quantity`.

usageLimit.description: Uses in total; omit or null for no limit.

oncePerCustomer.description: Each contact may use the code on one order (cancelled ones don't count).

get.description: The store's general, payment, shipping and checkout settings. A workspace that never saved any gets the defaults.

orderingAvailable.description: Whether customers can place orders at all.

webshopProductView.description: How the web shop lists products.

openHoursId.description: Open-hours schedule orders are taken in (Pro); null is always open. Get it from `openHours.list`.

searchProducts.description: Let customers search products by message (Pro).

facebookPixelId.description: Facebook Pixel id loaded on the web shop (Pro).

abandonedCartDelayMinutes.description: Minutes after the customer leaves a cart before the reminder (Pro); null disables it. One of 5, 10, 15, 30, 45, 60, 120, 180, 240, 300, 360, 420, 480, 540, 600, 720, 840, 1080, 1200, 1440.

abandonedCartFlowId.description: Flow run for the customer when their cart is abandoned; null only emits the `cartAbandoned` trigger event. Get it from `flows.list`.

productButtons.description: Buttons shown on each product inside the bot.

allowRateOrders.description: Let customers rate a completed order.

notifyOnCartStatusChange.description: Message the customer when their order changes status.

paymentMethods.description: Payment methods offered at checkout: `cod` (cash on delivery), `stripe` (card) and `paypal`. Stripe and PayPal must be connected first (`paymentProviders.list`); PayPal only takes some currencies (not VND).

currency.description: ISO 4217 code every order is charged in, e.g. `VND`.

currencyPosition.description: Whether the symbol goes before or after the amount.

currencySymbol.description: Symbol shown with prices, e.g. `₫`. Null shows the code.

serviceFeePercent.description: Percentage of the subtotal added to every order, 0–100.

shippingType.description: `none`, `delivery` to the customer, `pickup` in the store, or `deliveryAndPickup` (the customer picks).

shippingCountries.description: ISO 3166 country codes the store delivers to.

defaultShippingCountry.description: Country pre-selected at checkout; must be in the list.

deliveryCost.description: Flat delivery fee added to delivery orders.

checkoutMode.description: `default` our checkout page, `externalLink` a custom external checkout page, `flow` start a flow, `productPage` visit the product's external page (`productUrl`).

checkoutFlowId.description: Flow to start, required when `checkoutMode` is `flow`. Get it from `flows.list`.

minimumOrderValue.description: Smallest subtotal that can be ordered; 0 for none.

orderConfirmationMode.description: What the customer gets when their order is placed: `default` the built-in confirmation (order details, in the workspace language), `flow` run `orderConfirmationFlowId` instead, `none` nothing. The `newOrder` trigger event fires either way.

orderConfirmationFlowId.description: Flow run in the customer's conversation when their order is placed, required when `orderConfirmationMode` is `flow`. Get it from `flows.list`.

proFeatures.description: Which Pro settings this workspace may turn on.

productsInOtherCurrency.description: Products priced in a currency other than `payments.currency`. Orders still charge their price in the store currency.

anyOf.description: Sends one message (text, image, or file), optionally with quick-reply buttons.
Sends an existing WhatsApp message template.
Sends products from the workspace catalog (single product, product list or carousel; use sendViewCatalog to open the whole catalog). Only on channels that support product messages.

Shares the product catalog: a message with a button that opens it. Publish rejects it on channels that cannot deliver it (see `capabilities.get`'s `unsupportedSteps`); in an omnichannel flow (`channel` omitted) it is accepted but only sent to WhatsApp contacts, so set `channel` to check it at publish.
Pauses the flow for a fixed duration before continuing.
Splits the flow by contact-filter-style conditions. Terminal within its step list — nothing may follow a `branch` at the same level; continue inside `cases[].then` / `otherwise` instead.
Performs a workspace side-effect: tag, custom field, or conversation action.

Runs a Pipelines (CRM kanban) action for the contact: addToPipeline, moveToStage, changeValue, assign, changeStatus, changePriority, changeDueDate, changeTitle, setCustomField, clearCustomField, changeDescription, removeFromPipeline, addComment or transfer. Pipelines, stages and fields are referenced by name/referenceName (see `pipelines.list` / `pipelines.get`). Success continues to the next step; `onError` / `onSkip` hold the steps for those outcomes.
Starts another flow for the contact; this flow keeps running afterward (an ordinary step may follow).
Adds an internal note to the conversation.
Terminal — routes to an already-defined step instead of continuing. Must be the last step in its list.

matchPhone.description: Customer matching: a single `{{variable}}` that resolves to the contact's phone number, e.g. `{{phone}}` or a custom field. It must be an international number; anything else is not sent. Same rules as `matchEmail`.

customerType.description: Optional: whether the customer is "NEW" or "RETURNING" when the conversion happened, or a `{{variable}}`. Sent to Google as a user property, only when ad user data consent is granted. Blank sends nothing.

customerValueBucket.description: Optional: how valuable the customer is, "LOW", "MEDIUM" or "HIGH", or a `{{variable}}`. Same rules as `customerType`.

conversionTime.description: Optional time the conversion happened: a date-time with a timezone such as `2026-10-08T14:30:00+07:00`, or a `{{variable}}`. Leave unset to use the time the step runs. Cannot be in the future.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional client-generated key (e.g. a UUID, max 255 chars) that makes this write safe to retry. Replaying the same key on the same operation within 24 hours returns the original 2xx response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; reusing it with a different payload returns 422, and a key whose first request is still running returns 409. Only successful responses are stored, so a failed attempt releases the key.

put.description: Overwrites the draft version's nodes/edges in place, without publishing. Accepts either the raw `{ nodes, edges }` graph the builder UI sends, or `{ spec }` compiled server-side into that same graph — draft nodes are not otherwise validated (see `flows.validate` to check a spec before writing it). Unlike `flows.create`, a raw node's `id` is persisted verbatim, not remapped, so it must already be a numeric string (the same format `flows.create`'s `nodeIds` response and `flows.get` return).

parameters.description: Optional client-generated key (e.g. a UUID, max 255 chars) that makes this write safe to retry. Replaying the same key on the same operation within 24 hours returns the original 2xx response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; reusing it with a different payload returns 422, and a key whose first request is still running returns 409. Only successful responses are stored, so a failed attempt releases the key.

post.description: Places an order from product ids (`products.list`). Prices, discounts and taxes come from the products; delivery cost and service fee from the store settings (`ecommerceSettings.get`), in the store currency. Stock is taken from tracked products; an out-of-stock product refuses the whole order. The order starts `pending`. Paid by cash on delivery unless `paymentMethod` is `stripe` or `paypal`: then it waits for its payment until `paymentExpiresAt` (30 minutes) and is cancelled if none comes — get the page to pay on with `orders.getPaymentLink`. Nothing is announced (confirmation, `newOrder`) until it is paid.

get.description: Returns a link to the web shop signed for one customer: they browse, fill their cart and place a cash-on-delivery order as that contact, and get the order messages in their conversation. Without a contact it is a preview link that cannot order (any token may request one); a link for a contact can change that contact's cart and place orders, so it needs a token with write permission, not a read-only one. Optionally opens on a product's page (`products.list`), a vendor (`productVendors.list`), a category (`productCategories.list`) or the cart. get.description: Use this to find working-hours ids before inspecting or changing one. Returns every schedule with its intervals and member user ids. Intervals are in the workspace timezone: `weekday` 0=Sunday..6=Saturday, `startMinute`/`endMinute` are minutes since local midnight, end-exclusive (`24:00` = 1440). A member belongs to at most one schedule. Reply-time analytics count only time inside the replying agent's schedule; agents without a schedule are measured on wall-clock time. A date can override the weekly intervals: first the schedule's own `dateOverrides`, then the workspace-wide holidays (`workingHours.listHolidays`); `ranges: []` means closed all day.
